overview: EU text watermarking rolls out with opt‑in API option, highlighting early‑stage detection limits

Specialized Arabic dialect model released, showing focus on regional language nuance

top.title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
top.summary: OpenAI adds invisible text watermarking (textGrain) for EU ChatGPT and Codex outputs, optional for API users, citing detection limits and plans open‑source release.

top.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
top.summary: OpenAI introduces a visual ad format in ChatGPT, testing in the US, with expanded measurement integrations and early partner performance data.

top.title: Falcon-Emirati: When an LLM Learns the Dialect, the Culture, and the Nuance
top.summary: Hugging Face releases Falcon‑Emirati‑7B, a dialect‑specific Arabic model built on Falcon‑H1, targeting Emirati language nuances and cultural context.

top.title: Introducing GLM 5.3 on Amazon Bedrock
top.summary: AWS Bedrock now offers GLM 5.3, a 753B MoE model optimized for coding and long‑context agentic tasks, with prompt caching and API access.

top.title: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex
top.summary: The Verge reports OpenAI’s EU‑only textGrain rollout, noting it isn’t a global default, opt‑in API option, and limited detector access for researchers.

top.title: OpenAI PR tells journalist to ‘move on’ while asking Sam Altman about a ChatGPT user’s suicide
top.summary: OpenAI publicist urged a Vanity Fair journalist to move on from a ChatGPT‑related suicide question, sparking criticism over handling of mental‑health concerns.
